import math
q=math.sqrt
def mm(A,B):return[[sum(A[i][k]*B[k][j]for k in range(len(B)))for j in range(len(B[0]))]for i in range(len(A))]
def dg(A):return[[A[j][i].conjugate()for j in range(len(A))]for i in range(len(A[0]))]
def kr(*xs):
 R=[[1]]
 for B in xs:R=[[R[i//len(B)][j//len(B[0])]*B[i%len(B)][j%len(B[0])]for j in range(len(R[0])*len(B[0]))]for i in range(len(R)*len(B))]
 return R
def ov(T,S):
 X=mm(dg(T),S);z=sum(X[i][i]for i in range(2))/2;e=max(abs(X[i][j]-(z if i==j else 0))for i in range(2)for j in range(2));return z,e
def er(A,B):return max(abs(A[i][j]-B[i][j])for i in range(2)for j in range(2))
I=[[1,0],[0,1]];EC=[[1/q(2),0],[0,-1/q(2)],[0,-1/q(2)],[-1/q(2),0]];W=[[-q(3)+1j,0],[0,-2j],[1+1j*q(3),0],[0,2]];ag=(-q(3)-1j)/2;VG=[[ag*z/(2*q(2))for z in r]for r in W];VH=[[z.conjugate()for z in r]for r in VG];Q=[[0,1],[0,0],[0,0],[1,0]]
T1=mm(mm(kr(EC,I,I),kr(VH,I)),Q);T2=mm(mm(kr(I,VG,I),kr(VG,I)),Q);T3=mm(kr(EC,Q),VG);T4=mm(mm(kr(I,VG,I),kr(I,Q)),VH);T5=mm(mm(kr(I,I,Q),kr(I,VH)),VH);T=[T1,T2,T3,T4,T5]
G=max(er(mm(dg(x),x),I)for x in T);edges={(a,b):ov(T[a],T[b]) for a,b in [(1,0),(3,1),(4,3),(2,4),(2,0)]};route=edges[(1,0)][0]*edges[(3,1)][0]*edges[(4,3)][0]*edges[(2,4)][0];print({'gram_residual':G,'edges':{f'{a+1}<-{b+1}':v for (a,b),v in edges.items()},'route_residual':abs(route-edges[(2,0)][0]),'route':route})
